oneLiner: A touring kayak that lives under your bed.
audience: City commuters and small-flat dwellers who assumed kayaking wasn't for them.

story.name: The bag
story.fact: Folded: 84 x 56 x 24 cm — airline carry-on envelope; 9.8 kg with paddle.

story.name: The unfold
story.fact: Six creases, one tension lever. Median owner-timed setup: 3 min 40 s (n=14, owner-submitted timings).

story.name: The water
story.fact: 4.1 m waterline, tracks like a rigid tourer; self-rescue tested in chop.

packVolumeL.note: Estimated from CAD; production bag not yet measured.
